Get Basketligaen Team Roster

Source: R/sportality.R
sportality_roster.Rd

Current roster of a team, grouped by position.

Endpoint: GET https://www.basketligaen.dk/api/sports-v2/athletes/by-team-uuid/{team_uuid}

Usage

sportality_roster(team_uuid)

Arguments

team_uuid

(required) Team uuid: homeTeamInfo.uuid / awayTeamInfo.uuid in the schedule or teamList[].uuid. Key space: platform team uuids (not the numeric Genius team id).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "sportality_roster")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in sportality_schedule().

See also

family_basketligaen lists every function in this family.

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(sportality_roster(team_uuid = "rfo82vr830"))
